---
title: "NCAP city explorer"
---

A read-only companion to *Weather, Monitors, or Policy? A meteorologically normalised, quasi-experimental evaluation of India's National Clean Air Programme, 2015–2025*. Every page is precomputed from the project's pipeline; nothing here is live data.

::: {.callout-important}
## Read this first

NCAP units' satellite PM2.5 did not fall relative to comparable units; the estimates point to a relative rise of about 3–5%. H1 is not identified by this design, so this is not an effect of NCAP.

The registered test of whether NCAP listing reduced PM2.5 (H1) could not be decided by this design, because its pre-trend check failed. So no page here shows an effect of NCAP. Cities are listed alphabetically and are never ranked: the data cannot rank them.
:::

113 urban centres hold an NCAP city. Ground monitoring data exist for 85 of them, and a station valid every year 2018–2025 (needed for the composition-corrected series) for 20.

## Not covered

10 NCAP towns have no GHSL urban centre, so they have no satellite unit and no page here: Baddi, Byrnihat, Damtal, Dera Bassi, Kala Amb, Kalinga Nagar, Kohima, Naya Nangal, Parwanoo, Patancheruvu. They enter the study only in one sensitivity check (as small circles around the town point).
